workers.name: Daily DeepSeek Budget & Circuit Breaker Check
workers.description: Inspects Redis daily spending logs against DEEPSEEK_DAILY_BUDGET_LIMIT_USD and resets daily guest IP counters at midnight UTC.

workers.name: Orphaned PID Lock & Memory Sweeper
workers.description: Inspects .gitcontextgen/locks/*.lock files, checks PID liveness (process.kill(pid, 0)), and removes stale locks left by crashed agent processes.

workers.name: Weekly L2 Cache & Supabase DB Hygiene
workers.description: Cleans up expired 12-hour TTL cache entries in Supabase cache_store to optimize database storage and query performance.

workers.name: Nightly Typecheck & Regression Suite
workers.description: Runs a full production build and test pass to ensure no regressions or broken API contracts were introduced.

workers.name: Secret Scanner Pattern Integrity Audit
workers.description: Validates regex patterns in src/lib/sanitizer/engine.ts against modern credential formats (e.g. new GitHub PAT prefixes, AWS keys) to ensure zero secret leakage.
